Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
If a vampire uses superior Govern the Unaligned to add blood to a younger
uncontrolled vampire, then uses Force of Will to bleed, he has neither
repeated the same action by action type, nor repeated the action card
used, so it's OK, yes?

gomi

Messages.Author: inr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <8untqr$2ihv$1...@nntp1.ba.best.com>,

go...@best.com (Gomi no Sensei) wrote:
> If a vampire uses superior Govern the Unaligned to add blood to a
younger
> uncontrolled vampire, then uses Force of Will to bleed, he has neither
> repeated the same action by action type, nor repeated the action card
> used, so it's OK, yes?

Should be, only at inferior does govern state

Bleed at +2 etc.

At superior it's Add three blood... etc. a non bleed action.

So bleeding with force of will is ok, or freak driving and bleeding
with another card, or without a card. (provided you haven't bleed
already this turn.)

Cameron

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
